text:
maria: Heads-up: EconoCart is seeing rapid 429/latency spikes on their dedicated pool for the last ~3m. Customer reports errors and timeouts, support ticket #4567.
jon: copying. any alert firing? dashboard?
maria: yes alert: dedicated_pool_errors_high(econocart-pool) -> 5xx/429 rate up. latency p95 jumped from 120ms to 1.2s. autoscaler events show repeated scale up/down in last 10m.
aleks: can you paste autoscaler timeline? or query from metrics?
zoe: looks like scale-downs are happening too fast. cooldown is set to 30s for that pool.
maria: timeline: scale up +3 nodes at 1823456600, scale down -2 at 1823456660, scale up +2 at 1823456720, scale down -3 at 1823456780 — churn.
jon: oof. that 30s cooldown is too short for our workload. request bursts + short tails cause oscillation.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0456 (EconoCart degraded). Assigned to @jon
aleks: quick check: are there noisy pods hogging GPU on that pool? run: `redwoodctl describe pool econocart-pool --events` and `redwoodctl top pods --pool econocart-pool`
zoe: also check KV cache warmup stats. If cache cold, per-request latency spikes, autoscaler sees high CPU and scales then traffic drops.
maria: attaching logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:12:23Z ECONO req_id=abc123 latency=1450ms status=429 model=rw-large qps=45
2026-03-17T10:12:34Z ECONO req_id=def456 latency=1320ms status=200 model=rw-large qps=12
```
jon: that pattern (burst -> drop) causes scale overshoot then scale-in. mitigation: increase scale-down cooldown and add stabilization window.
aleks: propose: set scale_down_cooldown=180s, scale_up_cooldown=30s, stabilization_window=120s for econocart-pool. Also enable smoothing on the request metric (exponential moving average over 60s).
zoe: agree. also consider min_replicas bump to 4 while we investigate to avoid customer errors.
maria: can we do a short-term mitigation now? customer is on a paid dedicated plan.
jon: I'll run a quick runbook: 1) temp set min_replicas=4 2) set scale_down_cooldown=180 3) enable metric smoothing 4) monitor for 15m. execute now? :thumbsup:
aleks: +1
zoe: +1
jon: doing step 1-2 now.
jon: `redwoodctl patch pool econocart-pool --min-replicas=4 --scale-down-cooldown=180` -> applied
sre-bot: pool econocart-pool configuration updated by jon at 1823456840
jon: enabling smoothing: `redwoodctl set-metric-smoothing econocart-pool requests --window=60s --method=ewma` -> applied
maria: customer notified: we applied temporary configuration to stabilize their pool, monitoring.
zoe: I'll watch metrics and tails. if latency p95 stays > 500ms escalate to model/infra team.
aleks: next steps for root cause: reproduce locally with synthetic burst pattern, check kernel-level GPU metrics, inspect noisy tenant logs; also review recent rollout for rw-large variant.
jon: creating a repro job: `loadtest --target econocart-pool --qps-profile burst:60:10s:rest:10s:repeat:20` to simulate bounce.
maria: run it in staging first then ramp to prod if replicates.
oncall-bot: Pager suppressed, monitoring mode on for INC-2026-0456
zoe: after config change, I already see drop in scale events. p95 -> 210ms at 1823456880. errors down to near 0.
maria: excellent. keep the min_replicas and cooldown for 24h, then gradual rollback if stable.
aleks: file a postmortem once stable. include recommended autoscaler defaults for dedicated pools: scale_down_cooldown>=120s, smoothing=60s, min_replicas guard for small tenants.
jon: noted. I'll also add a lint rule to warn when cooldown < 60s for dedicated pools.
maria: thanks team. I'll update support ticket and send customer note. end of thread for now.
